title: Dining philosophers (deadlock)
description: Each philosopher takes the left fork first; explore to find the deadlock.

input.code:
# Three philosophers, three forks (mutexes).
# Everyone takes the left fork first: a circular wait (deadlock) is possible.
mutex f0
mutex f1
mutex f2

thread Phil0
  LOCK f0
  LOCK f1
  PRINT Phil0 eats
  UNLOCK f1
  UNLOCK f0

thread Phil1
  LOCK f1
  LOCK f2
  PRINT Phil1 eats
  UNLOCK f2
  UNLOCK f1

thread Phil2
  LOCK f2
  LOCK f0
  PRINT Phil2 eats
  UNLOCK f0
  UNLOCK f2
